scope.frontends: Actual GCC C/C++ frontends and RTL backend; original source reaches both GCC and the pinned original-header Clang reference.
scope.license: GPL-3.0-or-later WITH GCC-exception-3.1; independently implemented by wasm-llvm contributors.

nativeHeader.instructionChecks: Every enabled GCC operation must satisfy the fixture opcode contract inside its actual convert function; disabled/default modules validate without SIMD.

partialVectorCopies.scope: Scalar QI/HI/SI/DI/SF/DF memcpy reads/writes of first/last lanes; nonzero surrounding bytes must be preserved. No public header calls.

fullNativeQualification.note: Each completed execution matrix is counted once. The 16 inherited regression matrices retain all compiler directions and default controls. Header and independent SUBREG Clang references are explicit; nested inherited Clang oracles, auxiliary preflight and preserved earlier attempts are not added to the totals.

originalClangHeaderReference.note: This earlier independent reference used the same original public fixture bytes; the final native matrix separately reran all680 Clang programs.

sdkEngineProbe.positive: Actual Node engine WebAssembly.validate on SDK SIMD probe.
sdkEngineProbe.negative: Mocked WebAssembly.validate=false; no claim about an actual SIMD-less browser.

resolvedFirstAttempt.fix: Typed lane/splat target builtins retain intrinsic intent through RTL; aligned scalar views of native v128 registers use real lane extraction/replacement and preserve other bytes. Original public fixtures were not weakened.

wasmHost.note: Every canonical fixture compiles with actual packaged GCC in Chromium Worker and runs in both Chromium and Node WASI. Four separate no-flag header controls use actual packaged GCC/WABT/WASI LLD and SDK Worker execution, followed by independent Node execution. The producer manifest keeps qualification.status=unverified by design; these separate execution receipts establish qualification. SDK source and distribution files remained unchanged. All native public-header fixtures and the original Clang header were preserved.
